explain.progressing: Not ready yet: Knative is still rolling out the latest revision or its route.
explain.revisionFailedTrafficStays: The latest revision {{revision}} failed ({{reason}}). Traffic stays on {{ready}}, the last revision that became ready.
explain.revisionFailedNoneReady: The latest revision {{revision}} failed ({{reason}}), and no revision has become ready yet: nothing serves requests.
explain.routeFailed: The route is not ready ({{reason}}): requests may not reach the revisions as the traffic split asks.
explain.domainNotClaimed: The domain name is not claimed ({{reason}}): another mapping may already use it.
explain.certificateFailed: The TLS certificate could not be provisioned ({{reason}}).
explain.revisionScaledToZero: Ready, and scaled to zero: no traffic reaches it now, so no Pods run. The first request starts one.
explain.revisionProgressing: Starting: the revision's Pods are not ready yet.
explain.revisionContainerUnhealthy: The container does not start or fails its health checks ({{reason}}).
explain.revisionResourcesUnavailable: Knative could not get the resources the revision needs ({{reason}}), for example its image or its Pods.
